confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak tourist season and tourist tax varies. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor and typical Dutch café and bar pricing. The FX figure comes from secondary sites reporting the RBA's 16 October 2026 value; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Dutch cities with strong tourism demand, such as Haarlem and Leiden, priced somewhat below Amsterdam and above smaller regional Dutch towns.
